quote: Shadow can be a home too.
bio: Born in the depths, Dayan prefers forests and freedom. Her arrows always find their mark.

abilities.name: Sure Shot
abilities.effect: Adds 1d6 to the damage of a shot, declared before rolling.

abilities.name: Darkvision
abilities.effect: Sees in dim light and natural darkness without a light source, out to medium range. Magical darkness blinds her all the same.

abilities.name: Shadow Step
abilities.effect: Melts into one shadow and reappears in another within sight, at medium range.

goal: Prove that where she comes from doesn't decide where she's going.
